svg.title: Top: one learner's score for deviating dips below its score for holding back several times and finally freezes at a low value, although deviating really pays more. Bottom: the share of learners that end up holding back is zero when the fog is thin and rises towards nearly all of them as the fog thickens.

g.text: back, the learner stops deviating and the score freezes.

g.text: After one deep enough dip, it is never tried again.
